_readme.what_is_this: Topic sentences for writing practice at EIC (Escola de Idiomas e Cultura), Teens 1 to 6. A topic sentence is the sentence that states the main idea of a paragraph; here each one is written as an argument the student can prove with reasons and examples (not a general truth like 'Sports are good', not a tiny detail, not an announcement like 'I will talk about sports'). Each sentence is meant to go in the field TOPIC OR QUESTION of the printed Folha avulsa of the eic-writing site.
_readme.how_to_use: Read the list 'sentences'. Filter by 'teens' (level) and/or 'theme_code'. Use 'topic_sentence' as the text to print. All other fields are context.

fields.id: Unique code. t{teens}-u{unit}-{lesson}-{R or L} for a specific book text; t{teens}-u{unit}-x{n} for a unit-theme sentence; t6-{theme_code}-{n} for Teens 6.
fields.teens: EIC level, 1 to 6. Teens N uses the book Life N (National Geographic Learning / Cengage), same number.
fields.book: Book name, or null for Teens 6.
fields.unit: Unit number in the book (1 to 12 per book), or null.
fields.lesson: Lesson code in the unit, e.g. 1a, 3b, or null.
fields.source_kind: Reading or Listening: the type of text in the book lesson the sentence is based on. null for Teens 6.
fields.source_description: For grounding 'book': short English label of the Reading/Listening text. For 'unit_theme': the book's own one-sentence description of what the unit is about. null for Teens 6.
fields.theme_code: One letter: i, p, t, a, w, l, s, c, m. See 'themes'.
fields.grounding: 'book' = written from one specific Reading/Listening text of Life 1 to 5 (lesson and source_kind filled). 'unit_theme' = written from the overall theme of that unit, not from one text (lesson and source_kind are null); added to give units 1 to 3 of each level enough sentences to draw from. 'theme_only' = Teens 6, written from the theme alone because Life 6 was not available.
fields.unit_title: Title of the unit in the book (e.g. 'Hello', 'Lifestyle'), or null for Teens 6.

what_was_not_verified: All sentences are proposals written by Claude (an AI), not taken from the book or from an official EIC list.
The theme of each book text is Claude's own classification, not the book's.
Teens 6 (27 sentences) has no book grounding: Life 6 was not available.
The source_description is a short label of the book text, not a quote; the book texts themselves were not re-read for this file.
Level fit (vocabulary and grammar for each Teens level) was checked only by reading, with two independent model reviewers, not by a teacher or a vocabulary tool.
No word-count or CEFR target is attached to the levels because none was provided.
_readme.review: Two independent model reviewers read the first 224 sentences without project context (42 fixes applied). A third reviewer read the 75 'unit_theme' sentences (18 fixes applied). Suggestions judged too cautious or unsupported were not applied.
_readme.unit_filter_note: Each unit has few sentences (book rows: 3 to 5 per unit; each book has 12 units; units 1 to 3 of each level have 5 more 'unit_theme' sentences). To filter 'up to the current unit', use teens == N and unit <= current. Teens 6 has no unit; filter it by theme_code.
